mainEntity.name: How much does a Range Rover Velar P340 engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A complete rebuilt Range Rover Velar P340 engine typically costs between £6,000 and £9,500 for supply only [EM-QUOTE]. Used units start from around £2,500. Reconditioned units range from £4,500 to £7,500. Prices vary based on the specific AJ126 engine code and supplier.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of supercharger or cooling failure in a Range Rover Velar P340?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early warning signs include a distinct rattling noise from the supercharger area during idle or a sweet smell from the engine bay. Dashboard warning lights for engine temperature or low coolant. Unexplained coolant loss without visible external leaks. Reduced performance or hesitation under acceleration.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Range Rover Velar P340?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, absolutely. The Range Rover Velar P340 is a high-value luxury SUV with current market values ranging from £18,000 to over £35,000 [THIRD-PARTY]. A rebuilt engine cost is a small fraction of the vehicle's total value. It preserves the car's performance, refinement, and resale value. Upgraded rebuilt units address known factory cooling and supercharger weaknesses.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Range Rover Velar P340 engine supply and fit take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional Range Rover Velar P340 engine replacement typically takes 3 to 5 working days. Removal and preparation of the old unit takes 1-2 days. Fitting, calibration, and testing of the new rebuilt engine takes 2-3 days. Nationwide collection and delivery are arranged by the specialist.

mainEntity.name: Do rebuilt P340 engines include upgraded supercharger and cooling components?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, reputable specialists rebuilding a Range Rover Velar P340 engine will address known weak points. Plastic coolant crossover pipes are replaced with updated components. Supercharger isolator couplers are inspected and upgraded as standard. This ensures the engine remains reliable under the thermal stress of supercharged operation.

historyTimeline.h2: Range Rover Velar P340 - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: Launched as a performance-oriented option in the first-generation L560 lineup, the Range Rover Velar P340 paired sleek, modern design with a potent 3.0-litre supercharged V6 petrol engine, delivering effortless acceleration and refined power.

milestones.description: AJ126 (3.0L V6 Supercharged), 340hp, introduced alongside the Velar launch, offering a smooth, supercharged alternative to the four-cylinder Ingenium units.

Production of the P340 (and the wider supercharged V6 range) ceased as Land Rover transitioned the Velar lineup towards mild-hybrid four-cylinder and six-cylinder Ingenium engines for improved efficiency and emissions compliance.

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the Range Rover Velar P340 is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

commonProblems.h2: Range Rover Velar P340 Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The 3.0L supercharged V6 in the Range Rover Velar P340 is a robust performance unit, but its complex forced-induction architecture and cooling systems require precise maintenance. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing these original failure points, backed by a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Supercharger Coupler & Cooling System Vulnerability - Why the Range Rover Velar P340 AJ126 Requires Attention
problems.rootCause: The supercharger isolator coupler can wear over time, causing a distinct rattling noise. Additionally, plastic coolant crossover pipes and water pumps are prone to degrading under repeated heat cycles, leading to coolant loss and potential overheating.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace supercharger coupler, water pump, coolant crossover pipes, and flush system
repairOptions.longevity: Highly suitable for minor leaks or early rattling before catastrophic failure occurs

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of a rebuilt 3.0L V6 with upgraded cooling components and 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: Necessary if overheating has caused severe damage or the supercharger has failed catastrophically

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Range Rover Velar P340 holds a current UK market value of £18,000-£35,000+ depending on specification and mileage [THIRD-PARTY]. At this valuation, a rebuilt engine replacement cost represents a sensible fraction of the vehicle's total value, making professional replacement highly viable to preserve its premium status.
problems.recommendation: Proactive replacement of the supercharger coupler and coolant crossover pipes is a highly recommended, low-cost preventative measure. If overheating has already occurred or the supercharger has failed catastrophically, a full rebuilt engine replacement is the safest and most reliable solution.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt AJ126 Range Rover Velar P340 engine prices

problems.h4: Timing Chain Tensioner Wear - Range Rover Velar P340 Performance Vulnerability
problems.rootCause: Timing chain tensioners can experience wear over time, leading to chain stretch and a distinct rattling noise on cold starts. If ignored, this can lead to skipped timing and catastrophic internal damage.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Inspection and replacement of chain, tensioners, and guides
repairOptions.longevity: Viable if the engine block and internals are undamaged

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of a rebuilt engine with upgraded tensioner components and 12-month warranty
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if catastrophic failure has occurred or the block is compromised

problems.vehicleValueCheck: Given the £18,000-£35,000+ value band of the Range Rover Velar P340, addressing timing chain wear early is trivial compared to the vehicle's worth. Ignoring it risks catastrophic failure, making a rebuilt engine the necessary fallback if damage is done.
problems.recommendation: If caught early, a specialist timing chain kit replacement is the most cost-effective route. However, if the engine has suffered catastrophic failure due to neglected chain wear, investing in a fully rebuilt unit is the only way to guarantee long-term reliability.
